name: business-navigator
description: Business Navigator — MVP (frontend: React + Tailwind + TS, backend: NestJS + TS)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
